candidate_evidence.quote: TTFields will be delivered through 4 transducer arrays with 9 insulated electrodes each placed on the shaved scalp and connected to a portable device set to generate 200-kHz electric fields within the brain.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patient has a new radiological diagnosis of glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Device-only trial (TTFields/Optune); no drug or biologic intervention registered. Eligibility mentions IDHwt grade 4 astrocytoma only as the rationale for the age cut-off, not as a requirement, so cns5_terminology coded unclear.
